description: Spec 037 research R2 and T018: bearing-error conditions whose kinds are never drawn in the fine-tuning mix (configs/regress/ft-mix.json) or in any tuning. The first family (ho-t3: Student-t white error at the same sd; ho-step2: the error level doubles or halves mid-engagement) proved harmless to every system on tuning data (experiments/20261122-rmis-dev/heldout) and is kept as reported conditions. The strengthened family: ho-osc, a sinusoidal error of amplitude one sd and period 300 s; ho-burst, bursts of mean 120 s (about three per two-hour engagement) in which every bearing carries one offset of sd five times the error sd; ho-both, both: the registered held-out condition.
